wine-ink.$description: Wine Ink — Primary text, primary filled button background, active states, heading color, card borders, and dominant brand stroke — the single chromatic anchor of the entire system

midnight-wine.$description: Midnight Wine — Darkest surface for footer bands and inverted panels

lemon-whisper.$description: Lemon Whisper — Decorative accent fill and border — used in illustration blocks, testimonial card outlines, icon highlights, and soft highlight washes

blush-rust.$description: Blush Rust — Softened brand fill for secondary surfaces and SVG illustration shading

citrine-pop.$description: Citrine Pop — Rare saturated accent for micro-detail and decorative strokes

mauve-ash.$description: Mauve Ash — Muted body text and subtle borders when full brand ink would be too loud

parchment.$description: Parchment — Primary page canvas — the warm ivory that replaces cold white throughout

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, input fields, elevated panels — the brightest neutral layer above the parchment canvas

linen-beige.$description: Linen Beige — Hairline borders, dividers, ghost button outlines, and subtle UI separators

sandstone.$description: Sandstone — Muted borders and secondary divider lines on cards and links

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Lowest-contrast neutral for decorative borders and inactive link text

slate-smoke.$description: Slate Smoke — Body secondary text, icon strokes, and helper copy — the only cool-leaning neutral

charcoal-ink.$description: Charcoal Ink — Occasional dark text and info-toned badge borders when Wine Ink would be too warm

butter-cream.$description: Butter Cream — Ultra-soft warm fill for highlight zones and subtle surface washes

dawn-glow.$description: Dawn Glow — Warm card background tint used sparingly for warm-on-warm contrast

rose-whisper.$description: Rose Whisper — Soft card border accent for warm-toned testimonial and content cards

plum-echo.$description: Plum Echo — Badge and pill background for muted tag variants

tt-commons-pro-variable.$description: Primary typeface across all contexts — headings, body, nav, buttons, cards. The variable weight axis (400–600) and extreme size range (9px micro-labels to 85px display) make it the sole workhorse. Display sizes use aggressive negative tracking (-0.04em at 76–85px) for a sculptural editorial feel; body sizes stay near normal tracking. The 600 weight carries emphasis without ever feeling bold-shouty.

geist-mono.$description: Monospace accent for badge labels, inline code, and small caps-style tags like '+ AI AGENTS FOR ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE'. Normal letter-spacing — not tracked like the primary face.

open-sans.$description: Open Sans — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
